title: Mega-Bite Fishing Charters, LLC.
specs: Targets Redfish, Speckled Trout, Sharks, Cobia, Red Snapper, Black Drum, Flounder, and more
No fishing license required; covered by Mississippi state charter license
Boat licensed for up to 6 passengers; two boats available for larger groups
No air conditioning on boat; T-top cover provides shade
Boat accommodates up to 6 people; two boats available for larger groups up to 12
Trips can be booked for bachelor/bachelorette parties, honeymoons, corporate parties, or just fishing
includes: Bait, tackle, fishing licenses, bottled water, fish cleaning and bagging
Fish cleaning includes filleting and skinning, no bones, packed in Ziploc bags
blurb: Guests fish inshore, nearshore, and offshore waters targeting species like Redfish, Speckled Trout, Sharks, Cobia, and Red Snapper. Trips include bait, tackle, fishing licenses, and fish cleaning. The captain provides local knowledge to find fish based on the season.
extraNote: $50 deposit required to reserve trip; $100 deposit for 8-hour and Red Snapper trips and booking two boats · All cancellations subject to $15 cancellation fee; cancel with more than 48 hours notice · 3% non-cash fee for credit/debit card payments · Gratuities customary 18-22% for captain and crew · D’Iberville Marina, 3366 Bay Shore Drive, D’Iberville, MS 39530
